approved_by: Project Salus recommendation catalog v1 (non-prescriptive monitoring, review and referral actions)

actions.name: Flight surgeon review of cardiovascular trend
actions.description: Ask the mission flight surgeon to review the cardiovascular trend, the associated readings and any reported symptoms. The surgeon decides on further assessment.

source_references.title: NASA-STD-3001 Volume 1 — Crew Health, Revision C

actions.rag_query: NASA crew health cardiovascular monitoring medical assessment in spaceflight

actions.name: Additional vital sign measurements
actions.description: Schedule repeated measurements of the affected indicator under documented rest and signal-quality context to confirm or rule out the trend.

contraindications.reason: A critical clinical alert is active; follow the existing clinical alert protocol instead of a preventive monitoring plan.

source_references.title: NASA-STD-3001 Volume 1 — Crew Health, Revision C

actions.rag_query: NASA in-flight medical monitoring vital signs periodic health status

actions.name: Review rest periods and sleep schedule
actions.description: Ask mission planning to review the crew member's scheduled sleep opportunities and rest periods against the documented sleep accommodation guidance.
actions.rag_query: NASA sleep accommodations sleep opportunity rest schedule fatigue countermeasures

actions.name: Review operational workload
actions.description: Ask the mission administrator to review the crew member's or crew's recent task load and scheduling density before assigning additional demanding tasks.

source_references.title: NASA OCHMO-TB-016 Behavioral Health and Performance

actions.rag_query: NASA workload scheduling fatigue performance behavioral health spaceflight

actions.name: Increase fatigue and sleep self-report frequency
actions.description: Ask the crew member to record sleep duration, sleep quality and fatigue daily for the next observation window so the trend can be confirmed.
actions.rag_query: NASA sleep monitoring fatigue assessment crew

actions.name: Offer a conversation with the mission psychologist
actions.description: Inform the mission psychologist of the attention indicator so they can decide whether to offer a follow-up conversation. This is not a diagnosis.

contraindications.reason: A psychology contact request is already pending for this crew member.

source_references.title: NASA OCHMO-TB-016 Behavioral Health and Performance
NASA HRP Evidence Report — Behavioral Health, 2025

actions.rag_query: NASA behavioral health psychological support crew stress mood isolation

actions.name: Review crew connection and private communication opportunities
actions.description: Ask the psychologist and mission administrator to review opportunities for crew interaction and private family communication.

source_references.title: NASA HRP Evidence Report — Team Cooperation and Psychosocial Adaptation, 2022

actions.rag_query: NASA team cohesion psychosocial adaptation isolation confinement crew

actions.name: Nutritionist review of recent intake
actions.description: Ask the mission nutritionist to review recorded intake against the active nutrition plan and the completeness of meal logging.
actions.rag_query: NASA food and nutrition energy intake crew requirements

actions.name: Verify food inventory and replenishment options
actions.description: Verify usable lot counts, expiration dates and replenishment options with mission control.
actions.rag_query: NASA food inventory storage shelf life food shortage prevention

actions.name: Review recurring mission occurrences
actions.description: Ask the mission administrator to review previously confirmed occurrences of the same category and the actions documented for them.
